tags.title: Our Voltage (live) (19930516) (UK London BBC Radio 1 Peel Session)
tags.album: Basic Strategies For Going Out: Peel Sessions 19921993
tags.lyrics-eng:
One, two, three, four... You’re screwed up on surfaces
Pick the scabs, just assembly
Trap my nerves, frisk my brains
You want a reference, slide frame access
Don’t need the help of a mechanic
Your prognosis is another experiment
Always testing, always pouncing
Your little toys would break if they ever came near
You’re screwed up, catch your freak
What I want, kept secret
Leave me alone
You’re in there, under my skin
It’s sad to meet someone like you
Think you understand radioactivity
Fluctuation and our chemistry
Your system only measures what you believe
Your insistence on me to speak for you
Your persistence on me to impress you
High precision frequency
You intensify, you intensify
You’re backwards
You can’t see
For all your policing
Out of voltage
Genuinely

Off your scale

You insist on my response
Detailed, exact
Detailed, exact
Just for you
I despise your curious
Your persistence
The set free conditions I despise your intentions
Terrorism

No participation
You substitute meaning for anxiety

It’s not a battle cry

Let me out
You’re screwed up
You’re backwards
Suck on your tongue
Hope you junk on it
You’re screwed up
You’re backwards Your word is a virus
